description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic for handling deep links within the OpenClawKit application, including route definitions, URL parsing, and specific deep link data models.

classes.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink
classes.description: Represents a deep link to connect to a gateway, including URL components and methods to parse setup codes.

classes.name: AgentDeepLink
classes.description: Represents a deep link to an agent with message and session details.

methods.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink.init
methods.description: Initializer for GatewayConnectDeepLink with host, port, tls, and optional credentials.

methods.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink.websocketURL
methods.description: Constructs the websocket URL based on TLS and host information.

methods.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink.fromSetupCode
methods.description: Parses a base64url-encoded JSON setup code into a GatewayConnectDeepLink object.

methods.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink.decodeBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into Data.

methods.name: AgentDeepLink.init
methods.description: Initializer for AgentDeepLink with message and optional session details.

methods.name: DeepLinkParser.parse
methods.description: Parses a URL into a DeepLinkRoute (agent or gateway) if it matches specific schemes and queries.
